input_messages.content: Hi! I actually need some help with my account and a couple of recent orders. I just moved to a new house on Elm Avenue here in Houston, and I noticed that one of my orders was sent to my old address. I’d like to update the shipping address for that order to my new place, and also make sure my default address is changed to the new one for future orders. Can you help me with that?
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to pull up my account.

Actually, since both my old and new homes are on Elm Avenue in Houston, and my recent orders should have the addresses on file, could you please look up the new address from my latest tablet order? I’d prefer not to type out my address details if you can verify it from my order history.

The second one—592 Elm Avenue, Suite 978—is my new address. Please update both my default address and the shipping address for the order that’s still set to the old place.

Also, since I just moved and have some extra expenses, I’d like to exchange the tablet I ordered for the most affordable one you have. Can you help me with that as well?
Yes, that’s all correct! Please go ahead and make those updates and the exchange for me. Let me know if you need anything else from my side.
Yes, please proceed with that exchange and the refund. Thank you for your help!

That’s perfect, thanks so much for your help! I don’t need anything else right now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
